## Disfrutar's creators all worked at El Bulli
![El Bulli on its last day](https://www.tastingtable.com/img/gallery/the-legendary-restaurant-where-the-creators-of-disfrutar-all-met/disfrutars-creators-all-worked-at-el-bulli-1660605286.jpg) Robert Marquardt/Getty Images
According to the [Disfrutar website](https://www.disfrutarbarcelona.com/web/upload/PRESS_KIT_en.pdf), chefs Oriol Castro, Mateu Casañas, and Eduard Xatruch were all part of the creative cooking team working with legendary Spanish chef, Ferran Adrià, at his highly acclaimed El Bulli restaurant. They each started working at El Bulli between 1996 and 1998, and have nearly 15 years of experience at what many consider to be the most influential restaurant of the 20th century — it's the only restaurant to be crowned the World's Best Restaurant [five times](https://www.theworlds50best.com/awards/best-of-the-best/el-bulli.html).
Their time at El Bulli instilled in the three chefs the importance of creativity, well as "the spirit of not confirming, as well working hard every day, and evolution," reports [The World's 50 Best](https://www.theworlds50best.com/stories/News/disfrutar-highest-new-entry-worlds-50-best-restaurants.html). It's something they've carried with them through to their ventures after El Bulli. The three chefs decided to become partners in 2012 and to run their soon-to-be culinary empire without any outside third parties, so that they could have total independence and control over their creative vision. They first opened the more casual Compartir in Cadaqués in Catalonia in 2012 before opening Disfrutar, where they are continuing to evolve on El Bulli's tradition of avante-garde cuisine.
